_metadata.description: Parameterized routing-table template covering models, jobs, and fallback chains. Drop in your provider keys and job names. Pricing fields are 2026-snapshot placeholders; refresh them against vendor pricing pages before relying on them.
notes: Every cost_per_1m_input_usd / cost_per_1m_output_usd value is a 2026 snapshot. Verify before trusting.
expected_cost_per_call_usd is computed from the listed token assumptions, not measured. Replace with real averages from your trace logs once you have them.
Open-weights provider pricing churns more than frontier API pricing. Check quarterly at minimum.
Self-hosted entries set per-token cost to 0 by convention; real cost is capex plus power and is tracked separately.

qwen-coder-local.name: qwen-coder-32b-instruct
qwen-coder-local.verify_pricing_url: n/a: local hardware; capex plus power tracked separately

anthropic_then_open.description: Try Anthropic primary, fall back to a hosted open-weights mid-size on rate-limit or 5xx.

frontier_quality_chain.description: For jobs where quality matters most. Primary frontier model, secondary cross-vendor frontier, no degraded text fallback.

code_chain.description: Code generation chain. Self-hosted Qwen Coder primary; hosted Qwen Coder secondary; mid-frontier last.

low_latency_chain.description: Latency-sensitive chain. Groq fast inference primary, Anthropic Haiku secondary.

raise_immediately.description: No fallback. Job refuses to degrade. Caller decides what to do.

ticket_classification.description: Inbound support ticket classification into a fixed taxonomy.

conversation_summarization.description: Summarize a multi-turn conversation transcript for human review.

structured_extraction.description: Extract structured fields (sender, amount, due date, etc.) from unstructured documents.
structured_extraction._cost_note: 0.0165 = (2500/1M)*3.00 + (600/1M)*15.00. Pin temperature at 0 for deterministic JSON output.

customer_support_draft.description: Draft a customer-facing response that requires tone control and product knowledge.
customer_support_draft._cost_note: 0.0900 = (2000/1M)*15.00 + (800/1M)*75.00. Frontier reserved for the customer-facing surface; verify pricing.

code_review_comment.description: Generate a code review comment given a diff and the surrounding file context.
code_review_comment._cost_note: Self-hosted primary; marginal per-call cost is approximately zero. Capex plus power tracked separately.

content_drafting.description: Draft long-form content given an outline and a tone reference.
content_drafting._cost_note: 0.0270 = (1500/1M)*3.00 + (1500/1M)*15.00. Temperature 0.7 because tone variety matters here.

long_doc_synthesis.description: Read a long document (10k-100k tokens) and produce a structured synthesis.
long_doc_synthesis._cost_note: 0.1150 = (40000/1M)*2.50 + (1500/1M)*10.00. Gemini chosen for 1M-token context; verify Google pricing.

high_stakes_structured_output.description: Structured output where a wrong answer has irreversible cost (financial, legal, compliance).
high_stakes_structured_output._cost_note: 0.0600 = (2000/1M)*15.00 + (400/1M)*75.00. Refuses to degrade; raise instead of falling back.

embedding_generation.description: Embedding generation for retrieval. High volume, latency tolerant.
embedding_generation._cost_note: Self-hosted embedding model. No per-call dollar cost.
